verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Usage API, which reads real-time credit and concurrency usage for the account. That suggests throttling is governed by concurrency and can be checked programmatically, but no documented requests-per-second or per-minute limit appears. Missing for 10: a documented per-key rate limit value (RPS/RPM), documented concurrency caps per plan, documented throttling behavior and response codes, and independent corroboration.
